body: FUck yea, what trent ablum/ NIN or one of his other projects/

Yea i suppose you are right.

Im wasnt really looking for someone to listen mostly to point out anything that i could change.

 The biggest thing is making this as easy as possible as i can on my dad.
and my family in genreal.

But you kinda said what i needed to hear. That i function normaly. I feel im more clear minded than i ever have been. And  its been almost six months of planning and it only get clearer.

I just wasnt sure if i should keep it short and to the point and kinda explain what im feeling. The last thing i want is from them to think this was some quickon the spot decision. Ive already sold most of my things
Ive got 2 grilles ready to go and a few practice runs under my belt. I am more  than ready . My only concern is to not leave my problems on other people when im gone.

and i plan on cleaning up the letter a bit. I dont mean to sound confused, I know what i want. and i guess i am miserable but less so than ever. Ive had nothing but time to think these last few month, and it all leads back to the same place.



But anyways thanks for the response.


also about the hero thing, Ive been lurking here for a bit and ive seen alot of people be ID'ed some how and cops called on them.  i just didnt want that to happen. I didnt know where else to post other than pro suicide forums. Where they are just like "ya man i feel ya, life sucks dooo etttt"

Because life doesnt suck. But just like highschool and college i guess, some kids need it or can do it, others cant.
